title: Deye unveils 2.56 kWh hybrid battery for balcony, residential PV
content: The Chinese manufacturer said the system is designed for easy AC-coupled integration with existing PV systems and scalable expansion up to 7.5 kW three-phase output. The system purportedly delivers 800 W–2.5 kW AC output, supports up to 5.76 kW PV input with 96.5% efficiency.

title: SAJ unveils its ecosystem strategy and three new products at the elekeeper ecosystem partner conference
content: At its 2026 SAJ elekeeper Ecosystem Partner Conference, SAJ showcased new products for the residential and C&I market segments. The manufacturer is marking its shift away from traditional passive solar energy toward an era of proactive AI.

title: Singapore team builds 19.7%-efficient ultrathin ‘biPoly’ TOPCon solar cell
content: The ultra-thin TOPCon solar cell uses dual-sided polysilicon passivated contacts formed by low-pressure chemical vapor deposition. The champion device, with a thickness of only 80 μm, achieved 19.7% efficiency with 719 mV open-circuit voltage and demonstrated strong passivation, optical performance, and mechanical flexibility.

title: Record-dry April lifts irradiance across Eastern Australia
content: In a new weekly update for pv magazine, Solcast, a DNV company, reports that April 2026 was one of Australia’s driest Aprils in recent years, with widespread rainfall deficits driven by persistent high pressure and ENSO returning to neutral, leading to mostly clear skies and above-normal solar irradiance across much of the continent. title: Chinese wafer producers build inventory ahead of expected Q3 demand recovery
content: In a new weekly update for pv magazine, OPIS, a Dow Jones company, provides a quick look at the main price trends in the global PV industry.

title: Brazil increases import tax on batteries at local manufacturer’s request
content: The measure raises the import tariff from 18% to 25% for 48V LFP batteries intended for stationary applications in telecommunications and photovoltaic systems of up to 4.8 kW until May 2027, following a request from the domestic industry via LETEC. For other batteries classified as lithium-ion electric accumulators, the reduced rate of 18% remains.

title: Mexico launches call for renewable energy, storage projects linked to state utility CFE
content: The scheme targets projects of 0.7 MW and above, with a 935 MW indicative storage need, and is part of broader reforms to streamline investment while strengthening state-led planning of the electricity sector.

title: Colombia regulates transmission capacity allocation to speed up energy project connections
content: The measure aims to reduce grid connection delays and ease congestion in the National Interconnected System (SIN) amid rising electricity demand.

title: India has now 32.9 GW of operational PV capacity under private PPAs
content: Mercom reports that the so-called "open-access" solar installations were up 170% year-over-year from 1 GW added in Q1 2025. As of March 2026, cumulative installed solar open access capacity stood at 32.9 GW.

title: Australia opens tenders for 2.5 GW of solar and wind alongside 12.5 GWh of storage
content: Australia's New South Wales is rolling out two of the biggest renewable energy tenders in the state’s history, seeking 2.5 GW of new generation capacity in addition to 12.5 GWh of long-duration energy storage.

title: China invalidates First Solar TOPCon patent in major win for JinkoSolar
content: JinkoSolar has won a key patent invalidation in China against First Solar’s TOPCon-related patent, with the China National Intellectual Property Administration ruling it fully invalid.

title: ‘I still remember an HR director guessing my age during a recruitment process and assuming I would soon have children’
content: This week Women in Solar+ Europe gives voice to Marián Giner, Head of Engineering at Sweden's Alight. She speaks about systemic barriers, impostor syndrome, and lessons from sport and mentorship to redefine leadership as collaborative, transparent, and team-focused.

title: Chinese PV Industry Brief: Polysilicon prices remain flat amid supply-demand rebalancing signals
content: Polysilicon prices stayed flat in China as production and demand moved closer into balance, easing recent supply–demand pressures.

title: Slovakia plans to develop energy communities
content: Director of the Slovak Association of Sustainable Energy, Ján Karaba, told pv magazine solar is expected to become one of the key technologies used within future energy communities in Slovakia but said regulatory improvements will be essential to unlock the full potential of decentralized solar energy.

title: Solar and wind generated more electricity globally than gas power for the first time in April
content: At 531 TWh, electricity generated from wind and solar reached a new global record in April 2026, according to energy think tank Ember. Gas-fired power plants supplied 477 TWh.

title: ‘Buy the dip’ on T1 Energy’s Fuzzy Panda domestic doubt, Roth says
content: A short-seller report suggesting T1 Energy is not compliant with FEOC restrictions from claiming US clean energy tax credits sent the stock down 13%, before heavy market activity drove the price back toward 52-week highs the next day.

title: Inlyte Energy plans pilot projects to prove its iron-sodium battery technology
content: The California-based company says its technology is the perfect match for data centers, providing low-degradation long-duration energy storage while serving as a middle layer between the grid and highly volatile power needs of data centers. Now it's set to prove it.

title: Polar Racking launches solar asset management division for North American market
content: The mounting and tracking provider expanded its portfolio into a lifecycle O&M practice targeting gradual mechanical degradation and tracker logic faults.

title: U.S. solar policy risks multiply as reconciliation speculation and financing friction rise
content: As the U.S. solar industry continues to adjust to life under the One Big Beautiful Bill Act (OBBBA), Jesse Pichel and Lev Seleznov of Roth Capital Partners note two risks that are drawing attention across the market. These include the potential for a second reconciliation bill that could reopen elements of solar policy, and continued friction in tax equity and tax credit transfer markets tied to unresolved Foreign Entity of Concern (FEOC) and Prohibited Foreign Entities (PFE) guidance. title: Oil in turmoil, solar stays stable
content: Soaring energy costs have grabbed headlines around the world the past two months, but prices across the solar supply chain are marching to their own beat, writes Hanwei Wu of OPIS. Oversupply in Asia continues to distort markets, with either sharp price falls or tepid price gains.

title: Antora’s hot carbon thermal batteries win 5 GWh energy storage project
content: Grok Ventures has provided project-level financing as the sole external investor on a US-based 5 GWh thermal energy storage system providing 50 MW of round-the-clock energy through an offtake agreement with biofuels giant, POET.

title: LDES investor Frontier Power acquires 480MWh Texas BESS portfolio from Bimergen
content: Long-duration energy storage (LDES) development and investment company Frontier Power USA (FPUSA) has acquired a 480MWh battery energy storage system (BESS) portfolio from developer-operator Bimergen Energy.

title: Germany market participants starting to price 2029-onwards projects despite uncertainty
content: The situation and uncertainty around grid connections and grid fees in Germany is evolving, possibly enabling market participants to look beyond the August 2029 grid fee exemption cut-off date - although uncertainty is still very high.

title: EDF completes 120MWh Poland BESS; Eurus, NGEN and Aretis progress other CEE projects
content: EDF Power Solutions has commissioned a 50MW/120MWh BESS project in Poland, Eurus has done the same in Hungary, while NGEN and Aretis Group have financed and enlisted optimisers (respectively) for projects in Hungary, Romania, Poland, Slovenia and Latvia.
